caption: R61 500 between us and people assume that means loose money. It doesn't. Is a bigger combined income actually easier to manage, or just easier to hide behind?

slides.title:
How we spend
our R61 500
household income
Living in Ballito
slides.body:
Him 36, her 34
Married, no kids
Jobs: Structural engineer & physiotherapist
Combined net: R61 500 p/m

slides.title: Bond repayment
slides.includes: New build, moved up from Durban for the beach lifestyle
slides.body: The commute got longer. Neither of us minds enough to move back.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Woolies more than either of us will admit to, plus the weekly padkos habit
slides.body: We could easily spend a third less here. We've just never had to.

slides.title: Car instalments
slides.includes: Two cars, for two people who both work from home three days a week
slides.body: We know. We've had this conversation and bought the second car anyway.

slides.title: Retirement annuity & TFSA
slides.includes: Both of us contribute, split roughly down the middle
slides.body: Not saving as much as the internet says we should. We've made peace with that.

slides.title: Domestic worker & garden service
slides.includes: Twice a week each, non-negotiable with both of us working full time
slides.body: The one line where more money genuinely bought us back time.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Medical aid, both car insurances, electricity, fibre & phones, gym, holiday savings, TFSA top-ups, funeral policies
slides.body: Nine small line items between two people who both earn well. Still adds up faster than either of us expects.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R61 500 between us. Most people assume Ballito money means loose money. It doesn't.

slides.title: We stopped assuming a bigger income meant a bigger cushion
slides.body:
We put both our statements into Beyond Horizon and split the budget by category instead of by guesswork.

The two car instalments next to each other were the number that actually made us pause.

No bank login needed.
